description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableResources' which implements the 'Resources' interface. It manages a collection of Resource objects, providing methods to create instances from a collection or JSON, retrieve, add, remove resources, and serialize to JSON. It ensures immutability, thread-safety, and includes functionality for JSON conversion and filtering.
